div.span:
1 · CELLS
key = (modulation id, PW log-step 1 %,
BW 1 MHz, carrier 1 MHz)
parallel fold per thread

2 · COMPONENTS
union-find over neighbour cells
±1 PW step, ±1 BW, ±2 MHz

3 · SPLIT REPAIR
join if carrier ranges overlap (±3 MHz),
BW ranges overlap (±1 MHz),
PW medians within 2 %

4 · PULSE-TRAIN COHERENCE
all group pairs (rayon)
join if max(cAB,cBA) ≥ 0.13
and min(cAB,cBA) ≥ 0.04

5 · NAMING
decision tree → library id or none

same library id → one emitter
no id → one unknown_ai emitter per group

6 · WRITE
emitter + signal per emitter
cluster rows per 1 s slice
(slices < 50 pulses folded in)
one PG transaction, one CH insert
